problem: Native XLS PivotTable data items were misclassified as Sum and default subtotals as CountA. Custom-view hidden-row and zero-display flags were inverted. Native DBCELL zero padding for empty rows caused the optional validated row index to be rejected.
changes: Decode and encode SXVI item types with BIFF codes0..14, including COUNT before AVERAGE. Keep this enumeration independent from SXDI aggregation-function codes and retain unknown codes as Unknown. Correct the old generated test that incorrectly labeled0x00FE as a data item.

Interpret native custom-view hidden-row bit1 as Present and fDspZerosSv bit1 as displaying zero values. This matches native XLS/XLSX and the older Microsoft BIFF reference; newer MS-XLS labels contradict that evidence and its own hidden-row-name rule. Reserved hidden-row encodings remain errors.

Accept either compact DBCELL offsets or compact populated-row offsets padded with zeros to the observed ROW count. Every populated pointer must match its actual first-cell record, and padding creates no indexed row. Original payloads are retained; nonzero, interspersed or excessive padding remains invalid.

Add12 native owner tests and one operations test, covering reads, supported mutations, protection refusals and exact preservation/inverse behavior; expand the assertion index and feature notes without promoting historical fixture statuses.
